source_findings.finding: No haltRestart override in pinned source; superclass ultimately returns -1 without a configured PE_halt_restart callback
halt_all_cpus calls PEHaltRestart then spins forever if the platform fails to power off

primary_references.finding: With virtualization=false and secure=false, QEMU selects PSCI HVC; virtualization=true instead selects SMC
SYSTEM_OFF requests SHUTDOWN_CAUSE_GUEST_SHUTDOWN; SYSTEM_RESET requests the guest-reset cause
PSCI 0.2 function base is 0x84000000; SYSTEM_OFF and SYSTEM_RESET use offsets 8 and 9

activation: CMake PUREDARWIN_QEMU_PSCI_HVC defaults OFF and must be explicitly enabled; the built driver also requires exact qemuvirt-io loader marker
